title: The Oura Ring 3 Horizon in Gold just got an $80 price drop
summary: Amazon drops the Oura Ring Gen 3 Horizon in Gold to $269.99, a solid price for this polished smart ring with sleep tracking.
body: Amazon has cut the Oura Ring Gen 3 Horizon in Gold to $269.99, $80 off its $349.99 retail price. That works out to a 23% discount relative to the RRP, making this a strong chance to grab a premium smart ring for a lot less than usual. See the deal at Amazon
